feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 October 2026 3:58pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 16 October 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure will gradually build over the Irish Sea through the rest of today and tonight.


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 or 5 this evening, occasionally touching 6 around the Isle of Man and the North Channel, becoming generally North 4 or 5 early tonight, then decreasing North or Northeast 3 or 4 by end of night. Northeast 3 or 4 through tomorrow morning and afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later tonight.


##Weather##

Scattered showers at first, otherwise fair.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northeast 3 or 4, becoming Variable or East 2 or 3.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
